about: The offering of gifts accompanies a prayer for the Church. It asks for the flock to thrive and for pastors to become pleasing to God under His guidance.

seg.tr: Lord, now that the gifts have been offered, we ask You graciously to enlighten Your Church, so that Your flock may thrive everywhere and, under Your guidance, pastors may become pleasing to Your name. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

a.g: who lives and reigns with You

ex.w001: The gifts have already been offered when this petition is made.
ex.w015: The noun names the flock’s flourishing. The whole phrase asks that Your flock thrive everywhere.
ex.w021: God is the one guiding the pastors.
ex.w022: God’s guidance accompanies the pastors’ becoming pleasing to Him.
ex.w023: The pastors are the subject of “may become pleasing.” Latin names them after the phrase “under Your guidance.”
ex.w040: The word “God” refers to the Son, who lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
